name: orch
description: Code-first orchestrator for chaining coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex)

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle && bun run check:migration
scripts.check:migration: bun run overlap-report && bun run import-parity && bun test tests/_migration/__tests__
scripts.check:release: bun run preflight:release && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:project && bun run test:e2e:real && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle && bun run test:two-pane:full:real
scripts.test:two-pane:fast: bun test tests/model tests/tmux-argv tests/dsl/__tests__ tests/dsl/panes/__tests__ tests/dsl/drivers/__tests__/model-driver.test.ts tests/dsl/drivers/__tests__/full-host-static-app.test.ts
scripts.test:two-pane: bun run test:two-pane:fast && bun run test:two-pane:tmux
scripts.test:two-pane:all: bun run test:two-pane && bun run test:two-pane:lifecycle && bun run test:two-pane:full:real
scripts.test:int: bun test tests/integration/cli tests/integration/codegen tests/integration/core tests/integration/examples tests/integration/hosts tests/integration/observability tests/integration/runners tests/integration/services tests/integration/state tests/integration/validators tests/integration/workflows
scripts.test:project: bun run check:int-dirs && bun run test:unit && bun run test:int && bun run test:int:real-tmux && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:two-pane
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --coverage tests/unit tests/integration/cli tests/integration/codegen tests/integration/core tests/integration/examples tests/integration/hosts tests/integration/observability tests/integration/runners tests/integration/services tests/integration/state tests/integration/validators tests/integration/workflows
scripts.coverage:open: bun run test:coverage && bun run coverage:html && open coverage/html/index.html
